title: Preallocate INSERT schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when INSERT builds schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added insert_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.
Replaced InsertRowsContext schema lookup key construction.
